title: check-hnsw-index command result

scopes.description: HNSW-searched collections of the profile that were measured.

queries.description: Sampled live child chunks used as queries.

rebuilt.description: Whether the index was rebuilt (REINDEX INDEX CONCURRENTLY) because recall was below the floor.

recallAfter.description: Recall measured again after the rebuild.

description: Result of the command check-hnsw-index: the HNSW-searched collections and query chunks measured, recall@10 of the index against exact search (absent when no collection of the profile is searched through HNSW or the profile has no index), and, after a rebuild, the recall measured again.
